title: chloroleucon mangense var. mathewsii
intro: Chloroleucon mangense var. mathewsii, commonly known as the West Indian Mahogany or Island Mahogany, is a deciduous tree native to the Caribbean region. This plant is valued for its medicinal properties and is used to treat various health issues. The health benefits of Chloroleucon mangense var. mathewsii include its antimicrobial, anti-inflammatory, and antiseptic properties, which help to alleviate symptoms of fever, cough, and respiratory problems. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and tannins, which contribute to its therapeutic actions, such as antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and immunomodulatory effects.
